sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
 every six months as indicated by M6 in the above title block.

The first 
draft prepared by eng. Magdy El-tantawy & eng. Nora El-batrawy, and tested by
eng. Ramadan Helmy at 25 July 2005, 
accepted by: eng. Ali Abd El-Whab, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Abd El-Menem Al Emam. and approved by eng. Fathy Ragab. Head Sector of 
Talkha Power Station 2x210MW

هذا 
 الوثيقة مقبولة من قبل المهندس. سمير عبد الجليل: منسق EDEPC MPIS و 
 مدير عام التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة ومعتمد من المحاسب 
 محمود محمد سليمان EDEPC مسؤل. والتفتيش المالي والجودة 
 مدير عام الرقابة ومشرف التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة 
 قطاع الرأس.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued and qualified 
 maintenance stuff should carry the suitable safety category.

سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير 
 مطلوب المحيطة بمنطقة العمل.
ارتدِ معدات السلامة والصحة الخاصة بك مثل خوذة الأمان، وأحذية السلامة، ... إلخ.
يجب أن تكون الغلاية خارج الخدمة.

Don't allow to any material of fluids could 
 cause a fire in the work area.

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

Disconnect inlet signals of cable (HC 04) 
 which need to be calibrated by removing the cabinet sockets and put the socket 
 of mA source.

Connect the special cable of computer to the 
 processor diamo(S) card inside cabinet (HC 04)

We make software copy of the soot blower 
 programming from computer archive.

Inject inlet mA signal through the socket and 
 check the reading limitation according to specification sheet.

If the reading signal is the same, the system 
 is ok.

If the comparator of software programming does 
 not generate desired signal then make new copy of software from stored archive 
 of computer to the card (S 35) and check again the test ,if the test is ok 
 then the test is completed.

If the test not successful, then change the 
 card (S 35) and make another copy.

Check and adjustment for all soot blower care 
 in local part.

Check and adjustment the steam reducing 
 station.
